author: Abdelkader Boudih
description: A monotonic deadline token that derives child budgets, cancels down its tree, and raises only at checkpoints you choose. The shared time contract for the machines family: retries, circuit breakers and throttles read one budget instead of each keeping its own clock.

author: Abdelkader Boudih
description: HyperLogLog, Count-Min Sketch, t-digest, cuckoo filter and Space-Saving top-k, bound to Ruby from the no_std probabilistic-machines crate. Each sketch answers a counting question in memory fixed at construction time, and serialises to a byte string other languages reading the same crate can decode.
